card.name: Scattered mid-sentence linking words
card.fires_on: No single word or setting; it fires on assorted small words like can, same, and, to, commas and 's in general web prose.
card.plain: It responds to a random mix of small connecting words in ordinary web text, with no pattern a reader could use.
